items.title: Private sector credit growth slips to lowest on record
items.description: Private sector credit growth has fallen to a historic low as businesses lose their appetite for borrowing, shelve investment plans and banks stay cautious about lending amid mounting economic pressures.

items.title: Money market rates fell in Sept as liquidity eased
items.description: Short-term borrowing costs in the banking sector fell in September, with call money and repo rates reaching their lowest levels of the month, indicating improved liquidity conditions.

items.title: Capital Alliance to acquire 51% stake in HK fund manager
items.description: Capital Alliance Holdings PLC (CAL), parent of CAL Bangladesh, has signed an agreement to acquire a 51 percent stake in Hong Kong-based fund manager Asia Frontier Capital Ltd (AFC), subject to regulatory approvals.

items.title: Exits of foreign companies dent Bangladesh’s image
items.description: In the early 1990s, Grindlays Bank closed all retail customer accounts with balances of less than Tk 100,000 and sent cheques for the remaining amounts to customers.
